newsitem.title: JAPAN: Major currencies still in orderly reversal - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Major currencies still in orderly reversal - BOJ.

text.p: The exchange rates of major currencies are still in a trend of an orderly reversal, Bank of Japan governor Yasuo Matsushita told reporters on Wednesday.
Matsushita said the recent movements in the currency markets showed that "the major currencies have been moving in a trend of a so-called orderly reversal since last September".
Asked to comment on economic growth of other nations, Matsushita said that while the U.S. economy was showing promise growth in European nations remained gradual overall.
Asked to comment on the BOJ's less accommodative money market operations last week, he said: "We don't carry out (the daily operations) with an aim of expressing our view on interest rates".
